description: Every .claude/hooks/lib file each shared safety behaviour loads, relative to .claude/hooks/lib. `lib` is the require closure of the behaviour's Claude Code shell; `spawned` are lib scripts it runs as child processes. `bundled` is what a non-Claude runtime's hook tree carries (the two safety behaviours, the runtime adapter, and the dependency-free completion-check core the Codex and Cursor stop hooks require): the runtime shells there require exactly these files, copied byte for byte by scripts/sync-hook-core.cjs. Checked by .claude/hooks/__tests__/core-closure.test.cjs.
